request.subject: UNIT:KNIGHT

layers.text: Redraw him as a high-medieval knight: the horse's cloth becomes deep crimson red with a wide gold-yellow trim; a crimson and gold surcoat over steel mail; a steel great helm with a gold crown band and a crimson plume; a small crimson and gold pennant below the lance point. Keep the white horse, lance, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hooves.
